h1: Bahrain tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Bahrain? This page explains the Bahrain tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Bahrain tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Bahrain, but can apply online for an eVisa or get a visa on arrival.

sections.heading: What a Bahrain tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Bahrain tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Bahrain. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Bahrain business visa](/bahrain-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports may need to apply in advance, depending on their nationality. Residents of other Gulf countries may also qualify for an eVisa.

sections.heading: Bahrain tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Bahrain tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Bahrain.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Bahrain tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Bahrain tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Bahrain on a Bahrain tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Bahrain tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
